music.prefix: Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir, no lyrics. Background music for a dark fantasy tabletop board game about exploring a torch-lit dungeon. Acoustic, medieval-flavoured instruments, warm and close, recorded in a small stone room. Unobtrusive under play, it must not tire the ear over an hour: no sudden hits, no big build-up, no fade-out ending, steady dynamics from start to end.

sting.prefix: Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir, no lyrics. A short musical cue for a dark fantasy tabletop board game, acoustic medieval-flavoured instruments. The cue is complete within its first seconds and then the track is silent.

sfx.suffix: Close and dry, a tabletop dark fantasy game sound, no music, no voice.
